Copied unmodified from Amy's scifi-ui library on 2026-09-20, at commit
43857a2 (2026-09-15):

  https://github.com/amyleesterling/scifi-ui

  converge-swarm.css  the canvas the swarm draws on (components/ upstream)
  converge-swarm.js   holoconverge(host, target): particles stream in from
                      the host's edges and gather on the target
                      (components/ upstream)

Consumer: index.html loads both. The polity card (#tip) plays a short
burst of the swarm as it opens (js/app.js starts it and stops it after
about a second and a half). The swarm reads --holo-line, --holo-beam and
--holo-cyan from the page for its three tints; site.css sets all three
to the site's ink, so the card gathers out of ink on paper. The rest of
the library (the holographic panels, brackets and scan line) was used
from 2026-09-19 to 2026-09-20 and retired when the site became a paper
chart; the swarm alone survives because it reads as ink.

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, copy the same two down from a newer
commit and update the commit above. Licence: see the repository.
